newsitem.title: CHINA: Swire offers more upmarket HK flats.
newsitem.headline: Swire offers more upmarket HK flats.

text.p: Swire Properties Ltd, a unit of Swire Pacific Ltd, said on Wednesday it would offer a further 18 units in its luxury residential development The Floridan on Hong Kong Island at an average price of HK$11,423 a square foot.
Swire said the additional units were on top of an initial offer of 20 units and an earlier batch of 10 additional units.
The units are initially offered at an average price of HK$10,823 a square foot.
Swire also said 599 potential buyers had registered to buy the flats during a two-day registration. The flats will put for sale on August 1.

"This, on top of the strong response to our two-day registration, has prompted us to offer more units so as to satisfy the obvious end-users' demand there," said Wendy Gan, senior sales and marketing manager of Swire Properties, in a statement.
The flats are ranged from 811 sq ft to 1,187 sq ft.
